# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 10 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Eve Becomes Pregnant with Cain

---

**10:1** And Adam and Eve entered again into paradise, and God appeared to them in a cloud of light.

**10:2** And God said to Adam: 'I said to you that you are of the earth and you shall return to the earth. But I will also raise you up again from the earth on the last day. Then shall I give you all things.'

**10:3** And Eve conceived and bore Cain, and he was bright and shining at his birth.

**10:4** And Adam took Eve and the child and led them to the east of paradise.

---
*EMET: hyphenated compounds; chapter:verse format.*
